mintAuthority.summary: JTRSY is a non-upgradeable Centrifuge Tranche token using a ward-based auth system, identical architecture to JAAA. Active wards are Root (0x7Ed48C31f2fdC40d37407cBaBf0870B2b688368f), BalanceSheet (0x12a110cE5f0FC871cC72Bc7ECaF35cf39DD0f43e), and Spoke (0xEC3582fcDc34078a4B7a8c75a5a3AE46f48525aB). Mint authority ultimately resolves to the Centrifuge protocol 4-of-9 Safe via Root's ProtocolGuardian.

controls.label: Centrifuge Root contract (top-level ward admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,296,225, the JTRSY Tranche token wards are: Root (0x7Ed48C31f2fdC40d37407cBaBf0870B2b688368f, contract), BalanceSheet (0x12a110cE5f0FC871cC72Bc7ECaF35cf39DD0f43e, contract), Spoke (0xEC3582fcDc34078a4B7a8c75a5a3AE46f48525aB, contract). Same ward set as JAAA (shared Centrifuge protocol deployment). Root's ProtocolGuardian routes to the Centrifuge protocol Safe.

controls.label: Centrifuge protocol Gnosis Safe (4-of-9)
controls.evidence: Safe API at Ethereum block 25,296,225: Safe 0x9711730060C73Ee7Fcfe1890e8A0993858a7D225, threshold 4-of-9, version 1.4.1, no modules, no guard. Shared with JAAA — same Centrifuge protocol Safe.

controls.label: Anemoy / Janus Henderson issuer rail
controls.evidence: Anemoy operates the permissioned same-day subscription/redemption rail for JTRSY on Centrifuge, restricted to whitelisted non-U.S. Professional Investors at fund NAV. Actual on-chain minting executed by BalanceSheet ward.
